description: This file defines the TellerRequest class used to encapsulate data related to teller requests within the organizational module of the Fineract project.

classes.name: TellerRequest
classes.description: A Java class representing a teller request with fields such as officeId, name, description, startDate, endDate, status, dateFormat, and locale. It implements Serializable and uses Lombok annotations for boilerplate code generation.

methods.name: TellerRequest
methods.description: No-argument constructor generated by Lombok's @NoArgsConstructor annotation.
